title: Relative toxicity of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) in overdose
authors: Isbister GK, Bowe SJ, Dawson A, Whyte IM
population: Consecutive admissions for SSRI poisoning to a single toxicology unit in Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia
funder: not read: the publisher full text is behind a paywall and Crossref metadata list no funder.
result: Of 469 SSRI overdose admissions, 30 (6.4%, 95% CI 4.3% to 9.0%) were admitted to intensive care; seizures 1.9%, coma 2.4%, serotonin syndrome 14%. Citalopram overdoses had QTc above 440 ms in 68%, more than sertraline (adjusted OR 5.11, 2.32 to 11.27). Results read from the abstract.
